Plain text; also the separator name (aria-label default). Markup goes in the `label` slot.

api.reason: A-xstyle: use the host, `::part(base)`, `::part(line)`, `::part(label)` or the documented attributes.
The element itself is the handle.

api.notes: Host attribute; overrides the label-derived name (ElementInternals default).
Host attribute, resolved in the host tree; overrides the label-derived name.

differences.text: role="separator", aria-orientation and the label-derived name are default ElementInternals state on the host, so host aria-label and aria-labelledby win over the label exactly as upstream lets them, without the aria-labelledby id upstream generates for the rendered label (an id in the shadow root could not be referenced from the host).

The rule takes the Tecton divider roles: subtle is --tecton-color-divider-subtle and strong is --tecton-color-divider-strong (tecton-astryx components.ts `divider`); both weights are one border-width thick (design/components/divider.md: emphasis is colour only).
Under forced colours the rule is repainted with ButtonBorder, because backgrounds are dropped in that mode and a background-painted hairline would disappear.
full-bleed reads --container-padding-* custom properties (documented as @cssprop) that tct-section and tct-card publish, like upstream; the negative margins sit on part="base".

core.divider.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-web-components] separator role and name through ElementInternals, no id references across roots; [mwg:css-layout] flex, logical properties; [mwg:styling-web-components] parts base/line/label; [mwg:dark-mode] tokens resolve per colour scheme.
